[head=2][color=#bf4d00]New Crescent Workers' League[/color][/head]
The Workers' Union is an interstellar revolutionary union whose member territories retain substantial local autonomy. Chengridz is secure Union territory and the industrial rear of the Crescent Revolution. The NCWL is the provisional field structure for territory where that revolution remains contested.
[head=3][color=#bf4d00]Political and military authority[/color][/head]
- [bold]Flagman.[/bold] The League's field leader. Player-led parties or coalitions nominate the office; Chengridz ratifies the result and Kane provides the decisive signature. - [bold]Homeguard.[/bold] The professional Crescent force descended from local cadres trained by Workers' Union officers during the first uprising. - [bold]Unionkapitan.[/bold] A Homeguard field officer responsible for battlefield command and cohesion. - [bold]Partisan.[/bold] A frontline revolutionary fighter drawn from the League's militias and liberated communities.
[head=3][color=#bf4d00]MVD[/color][/head]
MVD officers remain Workers' Union political-security personnel. They do not belong to the winning League party or serve as a Kommissar's private detachment. They investigate counter-revolutionary threats, major corruption, intelligence failures, and whether NCWL leadership remains inside its provisional mandate.
[head=3][color=#bf4d00]Industry and support[/color][/head]
League administrators allocate fuel and ammunition, coordinate mining and salvage, manage captured infrastructure, and recognize local committees. Essential mines, utilities, refineries, and shipyards generally pass into worker, Union, or wartime administration rather than back to owners who supported the old regime.
[head=3][color=#bf4d00]How to address them[/color][/head]
Everyone is a [color=#bf4d00][bold]Comrade[/bold][/color]. Civilians may also be [color=#bf4d00][bold]Citizen[/bold][/color], and officers are addressed by office or rank. Noble honorifics imply support for the order the revolution exists to replace.
